description: Heuristic 6-label metric text classifier. Classifies extracted metric rows into audit categories using regex patterns. Labels require manual review before use as evidence.

inputs.name: metric_name
inputs.description: Name of the metric being classified

inputs.name: value_raw
inputs.description: Raw string value of the metric

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Source file path for the metric row (default empty string)

inputs.name: row_type
inputs.description: Row type hint: metric | equation | recalculation (default 'metric')

inputs.name: recalculable
inputs.description: Whether the row is recalculable: 'True' or None

inputs.name: result
inputs.description: Numeric result string if row_type is equation/recalculation

outputs.name: label
outputs.description: One of: observed / computed / reported / simulated / symbolic / unsupported

outputs.name: reasons
outputs.description: List of reason codes explaining the classification
